remembrance: Observed in code. Outstanding resource identity and owner are not stored. The idle channel holds up to MaxIdle opaque wrappers, each timed on construction, return or handoff. channel.go:70 ("conns:        make(chan *idleConn, poolConfig.MaxIdle),"), channel.go:88 ("c.conns <- &idleConn{conn: conn, t: time.Now()}"), channel.go:184 ("idleConn: &idleConn{conn: conn, t: time.Now()},"), channel.go:190 ("case c.conns <- &idleConn{conn: conn, t: time.Now()}:"). The FIFO slice is unbounded and removes logically via shift and reslice without clearing the tail, preserving a reference to the last copied or removed channel until overwrite or collection. channel.go:135 ("c.connReqs = append(c.connReqs, req)"), channel.go:181 ("copy(c.connReqs, c.connReqs[1:])"), channel.go:182 ("c.connReqs = c.connReqs[:l-1]"). Each requester channel has room for one reply. channel.go:134 ("req := make(chan connReq, 1)"). Release detaches and drains the idle buffer, leaves the waiter slice and counter alone, and keeps a local closer while draining. channel.go:226 ("conns := c.conns"), channel.go:230 ("closeFun := c.close"), channel.go:238 ("close(conns)"), channel.go:241 ("closeFun(wrapConn.conn)"). The counter starts at InitialCap, increments on reported creation success, decrements before live disposal outcome, and has no change on return, handoff, failed creation or release. channel.go:75 ("openingConns: poolConfig.InitialCap,"), channel.go:159 ("c.openingConns++"), channel.go:187 ("return nil"), channel.go:211 ("c.openingConns--"), channel.go:231 ("c.close = nil"). Late references resolve through the receiver's current availability and callback fields. channel.go:174 ("if c.conns == nil {"), channel.go:208 ("if c.close == nil {"). Runtime retention cost is unmeasured.
lock_discipline: Observed in code. Channel snapshots copy the field under the mutex. channel.go:96 ("c.mu.Lock()"), channel.go:98 ("c.mu.Unlock()"). Get admission, Debugf and post-start Factory execute under the lock. channel.go:131 ("c.mu.Lock()"), channel.go:132 ("log.Debugf("openConn %v %v", c.openingConns, c.maxActive)"), channel.go:154 ("conn, err := c.factory()"), channel.go:160 ("c.mu.Unlock()"). Constructor Factory runs outside the lock before publication. channel.go:83 ("conn, err := c.factory()"), channel.go:91 ("return c, nil"). Put selects delivery or buffering under lock, then releases it before overflow disposal. channel.go:172 ("c.mu.Lock()"), channel.go:183 ("req <- connReq{"), channel.go:190 ("case c.conns <- &idleConn{conn: conn, t: time.Now()}:"), channel.go:194 ("c.mu.Unlock()"). Live Close invokes Close under lock. channel.go:206 ("c.mu.Lock()"), channel.go:212 ("return c.close(conn)"). Ping reads and calls the callback outside the lock. channel.go:123 ("if c.ping != nil {"), channel.go:220 ("return c.ping(conn)"). Release detaches under lock and drains with captured callback outside. channel.go:225 ("c.mu.Lock()"), channel.go:232 ("c.mu.Unlock()"), channel.go:241 ("closeFun(wrapConn.conn)"). No reentrancy restrictions in the callback descriptions at channel.go:25 ("//生成连接的方法"), channel.go:27 ("//关闭连接的方法"), or channel.go:29 ("//检查连接是否有效的方法").
